issue_draft.title: Framework placement cannot resolve references to already contained imported catalog payloads
issue_draft.body:
An actual catalog-to-framework composition reaches a valid original SKILL proof whose local peer link already points to the imported catalog destination litai/samples/peer/component.md. Catalog apply has published the target and preserved imported ownership. Framework planning nevertheless returns applicable=false with reference-scope / unresolved local reference at line 138.

The original root source capture excludes litai/. Ingress supplements only finite initializer resource coordinates, producer metadata and retained native-source records; it does not observe this imported payload. Selection requires every local target to be a coordinate or observation. Thus an actual contained imported target is indistinguishable from a missing target. Imported/protected ownership exclusion is correct and must remain unchanged.

Add finite original-owner target observations, independently of move ownership, under the same native/root/Git/resource currentness and callback closing checks. Do not treat import membership or a caller path set as proof of existence/currentness, and do not broaden framework source proofs or grant directory ownership. Preserve missing/unsafe/private/alias/foreign-target refusal and all original preimage/lease/rollback checks.

Retain the existing moved-reference applicability assertion and full occupied destination rollback test. Cover already-contained imported targets, protected observed targets, missing targets, replacement/mutation after observation, foreign/copy callback injection and bounded target scope. No receipt/full qualification claim is implied.

Target resolution requires safe existence/type/native ancestry, not a content read. Keep credential-shaped/private/output/unsupported targets unopened and refused. Register target facts only through the original ingress source owner; retire/revalidate them with that owner. No arbitrary observer callback, caller path roster or decoded target fact may acquire effect authority.
